newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Dairy Board year revenue record NZ$5.3 billion.
newsitem.headline: NZ Dairy Board year revenue record NZ$5.3 billion.

text.p: The cooperatively owned New Zealand Dairy Board on Tuesday reported its revenue for the May year was a record NZ$5.3 billion, up from $5.0 billion.
Earlier, it had reported its payments to farmers rose 20 percent to $3.60 per kg of milksolids.
There was a $627 million increase in payments for milk to $2.7 billion from $2.1 billion.
Revenue from consumer business rose to $1.2 billion from $1.1 billion.
Revenue from its food service sector was a record $209 million, up from $108 million.

Chief executive Warren Larsen said the year ahead would be International dairy prices had dropped, competition had increased and economic conditions in several key milk powder markets would remain disrupted.
"Despite these conditions we expect further strong improvement in the strategic areas of business, particularly consumer milk power and food service," he said.
